notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.notes: In the previous update, the character's inertia was unintentionally reduced too much, so it has been corrected.

notes.title: Minor Fix #6 - Balance Patch & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
[h3]We have made some balance adjustments.[/h3]

[list]
[*] The time to lose pizza balance has increased from 1.5 seconds to 3 seconds.
[*] Character inertia (sliding) has been slightly reduced.
[*] The responsiveness of the balancing hand has been improved.
[*] Additional shelters have been placed to reduce player fatigue.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bugs[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where certain UI elements were not applied when controlled with the mouse.
[/list]


Thank you for your continued interest and support for our game.
Although there are still many areas to improve, we will keep working hard to provide a more enjoyable experience.

Sincerely,
AnomalyGuys

notes.title: Minor Fix #5 - Fixed an issue where the pizza could enter an unreachable area
notes.notes: Improved the issue where the pizza could enter an area that was not recoverable.

notes.title: minor #4 Elevator Visibility Patch in the City Area
notes.notes: It has been confirmed that the shortcut section in the city area is unclear. As a result, the design of this section has been partially modified.

notes.title: Minor fix #3
notes.notes:
Key Changes: Addition of Elevators in the City Area

New Elevator Added

[list]
[*] Location: Installed between the first and middle sections of the city area, serving as a shortcut.
[*] Purpose: Introduced to reduce the fatigue players experienced while recovering or retrieving pizzas in the city area.
[*] Functionality: Functions similarly to the elevators previously used in the Natural Zone and Snowy Mountain Zone.
[/list]

Elevator Design Improvements

[list]
[*] Functional Improvements: Elevators now stop slightly above the ground.
[*] Reason: To prevent pizzas from getting stuck between the elevator and the ground.
[*] Visual Improvements: The external design of the elevator has been slightly revised.
[/list]

Other Improvements

[list]
[*]Adjustments were made to some sections with insufficient visibility.
[/list]

notes.title: minor fix #2 - Adjustment of Difficulty and Visibility in Certain Areas
notes.notes: We have improved the visibility of certain areas in the game and made adjustments (lowered difficulty) to balance the gameplay experience.

notes.title: minor fix #1
notes.notes:
In the game's pause menu, the text for the Quit button was changed from "Quit" to "Save & Quit."

On the title screen, the Continue button initially appeared as a lock icon. Many players misunderstood this as a hidden feature, so we updated it to make it clearer.
